Name: Snowy Paths
Author: GoldenBuddle
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/695096044500942882/1023323222541873212/snowy_paths_icon.png[/img]﻿[u][i][size=6]Welcome to Snowy Paths![/size][/i][/u]
[size=4]While I was playing SDV, I was fairly displeased to discover that the only change for the paths
in winter was that they were shifted to a slightly bluer color.[/size]
[size=4]So, I finally decided to throw my hand into the modding ring.[/size]
[size=4]This mod is a fairly simple one, all it does is give the Brick, Rustic, Stone, Stone Walkway,
Straw, Weathered, Wood, and Crystal floorings a more snowy appearance.[/size]
[size=2][i](Depending on the response I get for this mod, I might take a crack at the other floorings, or
even see if I can make other seasonal versions of this)


[u][size=5][/size][/u][/i][/size][u][i][size=5]Requirements:
[/size][/i][/u][size=4]❂ [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
❂ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]

[u][i][size=5]Installation:
[/size][/i][/u][size=4]1. Install the Latest version of SMAPI[/size][u][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][/u][size=5][size=4]2. Download and Unzip Content Patcher into  [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
3. Download and Unzip Snowy Paths into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
Then Startup SDV via SMAPI and play! Everything should work well!
[/size][/size]
